_comment: Central config for The Interested Indian pipeline. Commit this file.

mascot.description: Chubby round Indian cartoon mascot, amber round glasses, spiky black hair, warm tan skin, cream kurta, off-white pajama trousers, sandals. 4 expressions: NEUTRAL, SHOCKED, CONFUSED, SMUG.

light.description: Cream bg (#FAF7F2), mascot right pointing up, India map left, amber footer bar. Even episodes.

dark.description: Navy bg (#0C1828), mascot left pointing up, India silhouette right, amber footer bar. Odd episodes.

themes.auto: odd episodes = dark, even episodes = light
themes.dark: deep navy #0C1828 bg, white text, amber accent
themes.light: warm cream #FAF7F2 bg, dark brown text, crimson accent

voice._speaking_rate_note: 0.25=slowest, 1.0=default, 4.0=fastest. 'gemini' provider implements this via SSML <prosody rate='85%'>; 'gemini_cloudtts' uses the native audioConfig.speakingRate field instead. Charon at 1.0 felt rushed — 0.85 works well for Iapetus too.
voice.gemini_note: Historical: Charon selected 2026-07-25 for the plain 'gemini' provider — deep, authoritative, tested vs Fenrir/Orus/Puck. Superseded 2026-07-27 by Iapetus for 'gemini_cloudtts' (see _gemini_cloudtts_note) — kept here since 'gemini' provider fallback still defaults to gemini_voice.
voice.gemini_cloudtts_style: Narrate in a predominantly American English accent with only a faint trace of Indian origin - like an Indian-born professional who emigrated to the United States 30 years ago and now sounds mostly American, just a subtle hint of the original accent remaining. Confident, articulate, sophisticated young professional narrator, smooth natural pacing, understated warmth.
voice._gemini_cloudtts_note: Voice: Iapetus. Style updated 2026-07-27 to the 'Indian-American hybrid, more American than Indian' variant — an Indian-born narrator who's lived in the US 30 years, mostly American accent with just a faint Indian trace — see voice_previews/gemini31_Iapetus_enIN_indianamerican_moreus.wav, the one selected (chosen over the plain 'classy Indian English' variant and over the equivalent Charon take). This is a deliberate departure from the earlier 'must say Indian English explicitly' finding below — here the goal is for Indian-ness to be a subtle undertone, not the dominant accent, so the style text says so explicitly rather than omitting it (omitting any Indian-origin mention entirely was NOT tested here and would likely drift to fully generic American, per the earlier finding). IMPORTANT (general, still applies): the style prompt's own wording is what actually shapes the accent — locale=en-IN alone doesn't determine it; confirmed empirically in an earlier A/B that omitting any Indian-accent wording caused full drift away from Indian. Goes through Cloud Text-to-Speech (texttospeech.googleapis.com), a different API from the Gemini Developer API the 'gemini' provider uses — Cloud TTS rejects plain API keys, so this REQUIRES the gcloud CLI installed and authenticated (gcloud auth login) on whatever machine runs the pipeline. Falls back to provider 'gemini' if gcloud isn't available.
voice.note: Provider: 'gemini_cloudtts' (default, Indian-accented via Cloud TTS + en-IN locale + style prompt, needs gcloud auth), 'gemini' (Gemini Developer API, simple API key, no locale/style control), 'elevenlabs', or 'edge'. Switch provider here or pass --provider flag.

stitch.note: Zoom ratio for Ken Burns effect. 1.05 = 5% zoom (subtle). 1.0 = disabled. Max recommended: 1.10.

pexels.note: Free API, no watermark, commercial use OK. Get key at pexels.com/api
